metadata.title: StillDrawn: A Benchmark Dataset for Inked Line Art under Image-to-Video Generation
metadata.description:
StillDrawn asks whether an inked comic or manga panel still looks drawn after an image-to-video model animates it. This record archives the benchmark: 29 inked panels controlled for content class and ink treatment, plus 5 ground-value variants, each with its line-art layer and generation recipe (full for 27 panels; described, not reproducible, for 2); all 373 clips generated by five image-to-video engines (and a sixth in a scout study) under a pre-registered protocol, with a per-clip manifest and metric outputs; the frame strips behind the failure-mode taxonomy; the frozen pre-registration and its amendments; the budget ledger; pseudonymised human-check ratings with the rating instrument; and the metric, harness and analysis code.

Files: stilldrawn-dataset (panels, line art, recipes, datasheet); stilldrawn-clips-<engine> (one archive per engine, stored uncompressed and byte-exact); stilldrawn-results (manifest, metrics, analysis outputs, human check, documents); stilldrawn-code (MIT-licensed code; paper source under CC BY 4.0). Start with dataset/DATASHEET.md inside stilldrawn-dataset.

All content is machine-generated. Some items were produced through commercial services whose terms restrict using outputs to build competing products; see NOTICE-PROVIDERS.md (inside stilldrawn-dataset), which is informational and does not modify the licence. Please do not use the items it lists to train generative models. The Runway and MiniMax clips carry signed C2PA Content Credentials: do not re-encode them.

Version 1.1.0 adds amendment A9, an exploratory, post-hoc follow-up registered publicly on 2026-11-03 (tag a9-registered, archived by Software Heritage) before any rating or masked number existed: two allowed-motion mask sets (dataset/masks/; one drawn by the author, one by a model run that never saw a clip), the masked-drift tool (metrics/masked.py) and its per-clip records (runs/metrics-masked/), blinded adherence ratings from two raters, the author and one new rater under a pseudonym (analysis/adherence/), and the results (analysis/out/a9_*; the record at the end of docs/PREREGISTRATION.md; deviations in docs/A9-DEVIATIONS.md). Test 2 was killed: measured only where the requested motion should not reach, Gen-4.5's line-drift gap to Wan 2.2 barely moves. Test 1 was not supported. The frozen league is unchanged. The six clip archives are unchanged from version 1.0.0 and keep their names.

Data and documents: CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT.
metadata.notes: Machine-generated content, released for evaluation and research. See NOTICE-PROVIDERS.md for provider terms and dataset/DATASHEET.md for provenance. Developed under the working name InkBench.
